subject: Quick qual: traffic buckets, dayparts, and 3-slot sync
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@innovamatics.com>
To: lukas_meyer@redwood.com
Cc: Kendra Lo <kendra@innovamatics.com>
Date: 2027-06-17T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in Redwood for embeddings + demo request

Hi Lukas,

We signed up for a self-serve account last week and have been poking around the embeddings/search flow. Early results look promising and the team wants a short demo focused on throughput and cost trade-offs for near-realtime search (sub-200ms target). Can we schedule a 30-minute walkthrough next week?

High-level context:
- Use case: semantic search + augmentation in our support portal (mix of short queries and long documents).
- Traffic: safe guess for now is ~200k queries/day after month 1, likely to double in month 3.
- SLA target: p95 latency <200ms for tail queries; batch reranks acceptable for some flows.

Attaching a small traffic sample (anonymized) to help sizing.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Head of Search & NLP, Innovamatics
Attachments: innovamatics_traffic_sample.csv (CSV - 12KB)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-06-17T10:02:00-07:00

On Thu, Jun 17, 2027 at 9:08 AM Sanjay Patel <sanjay@innovamatics.com> wrote:
> We signed up for a self-serve account last week and have been poking around the embeddings/search flow.

Thanks for the context and the sample, Sanjay — this is helpful. A couple quick qualification questions so we make the demo actionable (short answers are fine):

1) Typical query profile: what percent are short queries (<64 tokens) vs long (>256 tokens)?
2) Peak concurrent QPS during business hours vs off-hours? (ballpark is fine)
3) Dayparts: do you have strict peak windows (e.g., 9am–12pm PST) or more distributed usage?
4) Timeline: what does a successful pilot look like and when would you want it in prod?

Proposed 30-minute slots (all PST):
- Tue 2027-06-22 10:00–10:30
- Wed 2027-06-23 14:00–14:30
- Thu 2027-06-24 09:00–09:30

If none of those work, tell me two preferred windows and Monica (cc'd) will help align calendars and include an engineer who can speak to batching/quantization.

Also copying Monica to loop in our pre-sales engineer for sizing.

Cheers,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | https://redwood.inference

--

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@innovamatics.com>

Cc: Kendra Lo <kendra@innovamatics.com>
Date: 2027-06-17T12:19:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood for embeddings + demo request

Thanks, Lukas — answers inline below.

1) Query profile: ~70% short (<64 tokens), ~20% mid (64–256), ~10% long (>256).
2) Peak concurrent: today likely ~20–30 QPS at peak; after month 1 we expect bursts to ~120 QPS.
3) Dayparts: concentrated 8:00–18:00 PT with a hard peak 11:00–13:00 PT.
4) Timeline: pilot in the next 6–8 weeks, target production rollout by end of Q3 if pilot looks good.

Wed 2027-06-23 at 14:00 PST works for us, but Kendra asked if we could shift 30 minutes later to 14:30 to accommodate an internal sync. We attached the traffic sample in the first email (let me know if you need raw logs).

Sanjay

Attachments: innovamatics_traffic_sample.csv (from earlier)
